[transfer-limits-basic] Transfer limits on Basic (effective 2025-01-01)
These are the transfer and deposit limits on the Basic plan.

| Limit | Amount |
|---|---|
| ACH transfers out, per day | $2,500 |
| ACH transfers out, per calendar month | $10,000 |
| BrookPay, per day | $1,000 |
| Domestic wires, per day | $5,000 |
| Mobile check deposits, per day | $1,000 |
| Cash deposits at stores, per day | $1,000 |

Daily limits reset at midnight Eastern Time. The monthly limit resets on the first day of each

[transfer-limits-basic] Transfer limits on Basic (effective 2025-01-01)
reset at midnight Eastern Time. The monthly limit resets on the first day of each calendar month.

## Incoming transfers

There's no limit on money coming in by ACH, wire, direct deposit or BrookPay.

## New devices

For 24 hours after you sign in on a new device, BrookPay and external transfers are capped at $500.

## Need more?

Limits are set by plan. Support can't raise them, even for one transfer. Changing plan is the only way to get higher limits.

Still stuck? Chat with us in the app. Someone is there around the clock.

[transfers-ach-cutoff-v2] ACH transfer cutoff times (effective 2026-05-01)
make the money available.

## Example

If you send money on a Friday after 4:00 PM ET, it's sent on Monday (or Tuesday if Monday is a holiday).

## Faster options

- BrookPay transfers to other Tallowbrook members arrive in seconds, every day.
- Domestic wires arrive the same business day if sent before the wire cutoff.

## Limits

Daily and monthly ACH limits depend on your plan. See the transfer limits article for your plan.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

- Domestic wires arrive the same business day if sent before the wire cutoff.

## Limits

Daily and monthly ACH limits depend on your plan. See the transfer limits article for your plan.

[wires-basic] Wire fees on Basic (effective 2025-01-01)
Here's what wires cost on the Basic plan.

| Wire | Fee |
|---|---|
| Outgoing domestic | $25.00 |
| Outgoing international | not available |
| Incoming domestic | free |
| Incoming international | $10.00 |

You can send up to $5,000 a day in domestic wires on Basic.

## Cutoff times

Domestic wires sent before 3:00 PM ET on a business day go out the same day.

Standard transfers to and from your linked bank accounts use ACH, which only processes on business days.

## Cutoff time

Transfers you submit before 4:00 PM ET on a business day are sent that day. Transfers submitted after 4:00 PM ET, or on a weekend or bank holiday, are sent the next business day.

## When the money arrives

Once sent, ACH transfers usually arrive in 1 to 3 business days. The other bank decides when to make the money available.

[transfers-recurring] Scheduled and recurring transfers (effective 2025-01-01)
You can schedule a transfer for a future date, or set one up to repeat weekly, every two weeks or monthly.

## Set one up

Tap Transfers, choose the account, enter the amount, and tap Schedule. Pick the date and how often it repeats.

## When scheduled transfers are sent

On the scheduled date, ACH transfers are sent in the batch before 4:00 PM ET. If the date falls on a weekend or holiday, they're sent the next business day.

## Not enough money

If your balance is too low on the send date, the transfer is skipped

[wires-domestic] Sending a domestic wire (effective 2025-01-01)
| Fee | Daily limit |
|---|---|---|
| Basic | $25.00 | $5,000 |
| Plus | $15.00 | $10,000 |
| Premium | free | $25,000 |

## Before you send

Wires can't be cancelled once sent. Double-check the details, and be careful if someone you've only met online, or someone claiming to be from a bank or the government, asks you to wire money.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

Customer question:
I'm on Basic and need to send 4k to my landlord by ACH today. Is that possible?

request.instructions:
You are the help-center assistant for Tallowbrook, a US neobank. Answer the customer's question using only the help-center excerpts you are given.

Rules:
- Use only facts stated in the excerpts. Do not add fees, limits, dates, steps or products they do not mention.
- Some excerpts are older versions of a policy. When two excerpts disagree, follow the one with the later effective date.
- If the question depends on the customer's plan (Basic, Plus or Premium), use that plan's numbers.
- If the question rests on something false (for example a fee that does not exist), say so and give the correct facts. That is an answer, not an abstention.
- Abstain when the excerpts do not contain the answer, when the question is not about Tallowbrook, or when it asks for investment, tax or legal advice. Set "abstain" to true and say briefly that the help center does not cover it.
- Cite the article IDs (the text in square brackets) of every excerpt you used. Cite nothing when you abstain.
- Keep the answer short: two to four sentences, plain language.
